completion_data.completion_summary: All four probes compile sorry-free against source-rebuilt .oleans with measured axiom profiles recorded; the quantified transposition sentence now defines recurrence-freeness (qTrans_defines, byte-identical to the plan's challenge signature). The summary carries the ready-to-paste follow-up port task description, the manuscript remark's verbatim text and placement, and the completeness take-aways; nothing outside the task directory was changed.

memory_candidates.content: When a plan's challenge block pins a Lean theorem whose proof composes two landed results (here isAtom_iff/qRec_defines from QuantRecurrence and recurrenceFree_not_transposed from HybridTransposition), the plan-specified tactic script compiled on the first lake env lean run; the cheap pre-checks that made this reliable were (1) a guarded scoped build of every imported module so .oleans are fresh, (2) a grep for clashing clause-lemma names across opened namespaces (and_iff, exist_iff exist in six namespaces here) before choosing the open lines, and (3) a diff of the abbrev and theorem signature text against the plan block rather than an eyeball check.

A bare grep -c '^theorem' over a Lean file over-counts when a docstring line begins with the word 'theorem' (probe 03 reported 3 for 2 declarations). When a plan's Scope Hypothesis pins a declaration count, confirm the count by listing the matches, not by the number alone, before recording a discrepancy.

reflection.what_worked: The plan's step-by-step tactic script for qTrans_valid and qTrans_defines was executable as written; building QuantRecurrence in the Phase 1 scoped build meant Phase 2 needed no second build.
reflection.what_was_hard: Nothing in the proofs; the only friction was bookkeeping — the axiom paragraph in Appendix A stated 'every other theorem' as the choice triple when four declarations (three defs and one theorem) are lighter, which had to be recorded rather than silently reconciled.
reflection.what_was_missed: Handoff filenames were stamped with guessed future timestamps and had to be renamed to the real clock in the final commit.
reflection.successes: Four sorry-free probes, 30 measured axiom profiles, one new definability theorem with a signature byte-identical to the challenge block, and every commit confined to the task directory.
